title: feat: let community model owners advertise model metadata
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

- Adds optional advertised metadata for text community proxies: tool calling, reasoning, and context length
- Stores declarations in the existing typed proxy payload; empty declarations are omitted and no migration is needed
- Exposes declarations through the model catalog without changing request forwarding
- Rejects declarations for non-text proxies; agent listings continue to inherit metadata from their base model
- Adds My Models controls and focused catalog coverage

## Verification

- Pull request checks, Gen tests/typecheck, and CodeQL pass
- Branch includes the latest `main` listing-envelope refactor

gist.headline: Model labels, but useful
gist.blurb: Community model owners can now put the useful facts on the jar: tool calling, reasoning, and context length. Less guessing which model brought the right tiny wrench.
gist.summary: Text community proxy owners can now advertise tool-calling support, reasoning support, and context length in their typed proxy payloads, with those declarations surfaced in the model catalog.
gist.impact: People browsing community text models can see capability metadata before choosing one, while agent listings still inherit the metadata of their base models.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy community-model garden where Polli carefully attaches clear capability tags to blooming code-plants: a tiny wrench for tool calling, a glowing thought bubble for reasoning, and a long measuring tape for context length. A friendly CRT monitor robot reads the tidy model catalog labels while flowers and vines grow around the terminal.
